govt_add.name: Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) Officer and Supervisor Exam
govt_add.need: +2 or Diploma in Engineering for Level 4/5 Supervisor; Bachelor degree (BE for Engineer, BBS/BBA/MBS for Account/Admin Officer) plus NEC licence for engineers at Level 7
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Nepal Electricity Authority (written exam conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, Institutional and Technical/Service Basics
100 marks written paper combining objective MCQs and structured questions on the Constitution, Electricity Act 2049, NEA regulations and core subject.
Second Paper: Service or Engineering Discipline Subject
100 marks descriptive written paper on electrical/civil/mechanical/computer engineering or accounting/administration.
Computer skill test and interview
Practical skill test (where applicable) and 30 mark oral interview.
subjects: Electricity Act 2049, Electricity Regulation 2050, Electricity Regulatory Commission Act 2074 and NEA Financial/Staff Bylaws
Power sector development in Nepal, hydropower generation, transmission, distribution and tariff structure
Discipline specific engineering (electrical, civil, mechanical, computer) or financial administration and public procurement
prep: Memorise key sections of the Electricity Act 2049, Public Procurement Act 2063 and NEA Employee Service Regulations 2075
Combine Lok Sewa technical MCQ practice with long answer diagrams for Paper 2
Apply online via career.nea.org.np when the annual vacancy notice opens
govt_add.note: Written exams are conducted by the Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog). Application fees start at NPR 800 for assistant level and NPR 1,200 for Level 7 officer roles.

govt_add.name: Nepal Telecom (NTC) Engineer, Officer and Technician Exam
govt_add.level: Level 3/4 Technician and Assistant, Level 7 Engineer and Officer
govt_add.need: SLC/SEE + training or CTEVT Diploma for Level 3/4 Technician; BE in Electronics and Communication, Computer or Electrical (with NEC licence) for Level 7 Engineer; Bachelor/Master for Admin/Account Officer
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities; up to 40 for permanent NTC staff)
govt_add.body: Nepal Doorsanchar Company Limited (written exam by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Paper: General Knowledge, Telecom Act and Core Fundamentals
100 marks written examination covering GK, institutional bylaws, Telecommunications Act 2053 and core discipline.
Second Paper: Specialized Technical or Administrative Paper
100 marks descriptive subjective paper on telecommunications, networking, software/IT or management.
Interview
Oral interview for candidates who pass both written papers.
subjects: Telecommunications Act 2053, Nepal Telecom Employee Bylaws and ICT Policy of Nepal
Digital communication, mobile networks (4G/5G), optical fibre, IP networking and database/operating systems
Public enterprise management, financial rules and customer service delivery
prep: Download the exact level syllabus PDF from ntc.net.np and cover every unit equally as NTC gives no fixed chapter weightage
Engineering graduates in Computer Engineering can also check eligibility for Electronics and Communication vacancies if prepared for telecom subjects
Submit your online application at recruitment.ntc.net.np before the single fee deadline
govt_add.note: Per the Kartik 13, 2083 (October 30, 2026) Nepal Telecom vacancy notice, the examination fee for Level 6 and Level 7 is NPR 700 (plus NPR 200 for each additional inclusive quota group).

govt_add.name: Rastriya Banijya Bank (RBB) Level 4 Assistant and Level 6 Officer Exam
govt_add.level: Level 4 Assistant (Administration/Cash) and Level 6 Assistant Manager
govt_add.need: +2 in any stream (or Management for Cash) for Level 4 Assistant; Master degree in Economics/Management (or Bachelor with 50% in Management/Economics under updated notices) for Level 6 Officer; BE/BCA/BIT/BCIS for IT roles
govt_add.age: 18 to 35 years for Level 4; 21 to 35 years for Level 6 (up to 40 for women and persons with disabilities)
govt_add.body: Rastriya Banijya Bank Limited (written exam conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog)
stages: First Phase: Pre-test (Level 4 only)
45 minute, 100 mark objective MCQ screening test (50 questions x 2 marks; Banking, Accounting, Mathematics, Computer and GK; pass mark 40, no marks carried forward).
Second Phase: Written Examination (2 papers)
Paper 1 (100 marks: Banking, Management, Accounting and Customer Service) and Paper 2 (100 marks: Economics, Banking Laws, NRB Directives, Mathematics and IT).
Practical computer test and interview
Final interview (30 marks) plus computer skill check.
subjects: Nepal Rastra Bank Act 2058, BAFIA 2073, Banking Offence and Punishment Act 2064, AML/CFT and NRB Unified Directives
Financial accounting, ratio analysis, auditing, internal control and banking operations
Macroeconomics, monetary and fiscal policy, business mathematics and office IT
prep: Clear the Level 4 MCQ pre-test by focusing on NRB Unified Directives, BAFIA 2073 and basic accounting ratios
Practise structured 10 mark descriptive answers citing specific BAFIA sections and latest Monetary Policy figures
Apply online at career.rbb.com.np when the annual vacancy opens
govt_add.note: Conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog across provincial clusters; application fee is NPR 800 for Level 4/5 and NPR 1,000 for Level 6 (+ NPR 200 to 300 per inclusive group).

govt_add.name: EPS-TOPIK (Korean Employment Permit System Test)
govt_add.level: Government to government Korean language and skill test for work in South Korea
govt_add.need: Nepali citizen aged 18 to 39 years with no criminal record, no history of illegal stay in Korea, and no colour blindness
govt_add.age: 18 to 39 years (strictly enforced by birth date window in each notice)
govt_add.body: HRD Korea and Department of Foreign Employment, EPS Korea Branch (Gwarko, Lalitpur)
stages: Computer / UBT Korean Language Test (Reading and Listening)

50 minutes continuous test without a break at the UBT Building, Bhaisepati: 20 Reading questions + 20 Listening questions (40 questions total, scored out of 200 points; some notices list 100 marks per section or 100 total).
Skill, physical and competency test
Candidates who pass the language cutoff take a sector skill test (manufacturing, agriculture and livestock, or shipbuilding) and colour vision / physical check.
subjects: Korean workplace reading comprehension, safety signs and basic grammar (20 questions)
Korean listening comprehension of dialogues, numbers, instructions and workplace announcements (20 questions)
Basic physical measurement, colour vision check and sector tool/skill test
prep: Study the official HRD Korea EPS-TOPIK Standard Textbook Volumes 1 and 2 thoroughly
Practise 40 question 50 minute continuous UBT mock tests on a tablet
Attend biometric verification at EPS Office Gwarko one day before your scheduled exam date
govt_add.note: Applications are filed online at eoers.epsnepal.gov.np with an exam fee of USD 28 (about NPR 3,850 converted at the previous day Nepal Rastra Bank rate). Recent annual quotas included 3,500 for manufacturing and 1,800 for agriculture and livestock; results remain valid for 2 years.

govt_add.name: JFT-Basic and Japan SSW (Specified Skilled Worker) Test
govt_add.level: Japanese language (A2) and sector skill tests for Japan SSW (i) work visa
govt_add.need: At least 17 years old on the exam date (18+ for the SSW visa) with a valid passport; passing both JFT-Basic (or JLPT N4; N3 for taxi/bus driver) and one sector skill test is required
govt_add.age: 17+ to sit the exam, 18+ for visa
govt_add.body: Japan Foundation and Prometric (test centers in Kathmandu, Lalitpur and Pokhara)
stages: JFT-Basic (Japan Foundation Test for Basic Japanese)

60 minute computer based test (about 50 questions across Script/Vocabulary, Conversation/Expression, Listening and Reading) scored out of 250 points. Minimum 200 out of 250 (CEFR A2 / JLPT N4 equivalent) required to pass; fee in Nepal is USD 36.
SSW (i) Sector Skill Evaluation Test
Computer based technical skill exam in your chosen field (Nursing Care USD 8 to 15, Construction USD 8, Auto Repair USD 31, Agriculture USD 33, Food Service USD 33, Accommodation USD 55).
subjects: Practical daily and workplace Japanese communication at A2 level (Script, Conversation, Listening, Reading)
Sector specific technical skills and safety procedures (Nursing Care also requires the 15 question Nursing Care Japanese test)
Japanese traffic/driving knowledge and JLPT N3 for the Automobile Transportation (bus/taxi) track
prep: Study the free Japan Foundation Irodori: Japanese for Life in Japan (Starter A1 and Elementary A2) textbooks
Create a Prometric ID at prometric-jp.com and book seats early at Kathmandu (Dillibazar, New Baneshwor), Lalitpur (Kumaripati) or Pokhara (Ranipauwa)
After receiving your Certificate of Eligibility and visa, apply for your Nepal labour permit online via FEIMS (feims.dofe.gov.np)
govt_add.note: Per the official Prometric Nepal fee schedule (October to November 2026), JFT-Basic costs USD 36 (about NPR 5,000), Nursing Care costs USD 8 to 15, Construction USD 8, Auto Repair USD 31, Agriculture USD 33 and Accommodation USD 55. SSW (i) allows up to 5 years stay in Japan.

in person
Register at eoers.epsnepal.gov.np when the EPS Korea Branch Gwarko opens the sector window and pay USD 28 online in NPR
online
Attend biometric registration at EPS Office Gwarko one day before your exam and sit the 50 minute 40 question UBT test at Bhaisepati
in person
Pass the skill/competency test, complete the medical check and wait for employer roster selection via HRD Korea
in person
docs: Digital passport photo with white background

guides_add.name: Apply for JFT-Basic and Japan SSW visa from Nepal
steps: Create a Prometric ID at prometric-jp.com and book the JFT-Basic exam (USD 36) and your SSW sector skill test (USD 8 to 55) at Kathmandu, Lalitpur or Pokhara
online
Score at least 200 out of 250 on the 60 minute JFT-Basic CBT (or pass JLPT N4) and pass your sector skill test
in person
Interview with a Japanese accepting organization / registered support organization to receive a job contract and Certificate of Eligibility (CoE)
online
Apply for your SSW (i) visa at VFS Japan Kathmandu and obtain your Foreign Employment labour permit on feims.dofe.gov.np
in person
docs: JFT-Basic (or JLPT N4/N3) pass report and SSW sector skill test pass certificate
Signed employment contract and Certificate of Eligibility (CoE)

guides_add.name: Apply for TU MBA and MBS through SOMAT or CDMAT
steps: Verify that you hold a bachelor degree in any discipline with at least CGPA 2.0 or 45 percent aggregate
online
Submit your online application at somtu.edu.np or cdmtu.edu.np and pay the NPR 2,000 SOMAT entrance fee
online
Sit the written GMAT style SOMAT/CDMAT test (verbal, quantitative, issue essay and case analysis)
in person
Attend the group discussion, presentation and personal interview to secure admission on the merit list
in person

guides_add.name: Obtain a CAAN Commercial Pilot License (CPL) in Nepal
steps: Pass +2 Science (Physics and Mathematics), complete a CAAN Class 1 Medical exam and secure an offer from a CAAN approved Flying Training Organization (ATO)
in person
Apply to CAAN Flight Safety Standards Department for a No Objection Letter (NOL) before starting flight training abroad
in person

in person
Return to Nepal and pass the CAAN CPL written conversion exams across 9 aviation subjects (75 percent pass mark)
in person

Valid CAAN Class 1 Medical Certificate and CAAN No Objection Letter
Certified pilot logbook (200 modular / 150 integrated hours) and foreign ICAO CPL

providers_add.name: College of Applied Food and Dairy Technology (CAFODAT)
providers_add.note: Purbanchal University affiliated food and dairy technology college in Lalitpur offering 4 year BTech in Food Technology (48 seats) and MSc in Nutrition and Dietetics.

providers_add.name: Sirjana College of Fine Arts
providers_add.note: Founded in 2001 under Tribhuvan University affiliation in Lazimpat, Kathmandu; offers 4 year Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) in Painting, Traditional Nepali Painting, Sculpture, Graphic Communication, Classical Music (Vocal, Instrumental, Tabla) and Classical Dance, plus NEB +2 Humanities.

providers_add.name: National College of Food Science and Technology (NCFST)
providers_add.note: Tribhuvan University (IOST) affiliated college in Khusibu, Kathmandu offering the 4 year BTech in Food Technology programme (24 seats).

providers_add.name: Lalitpur Valley College (LVC)
providers_add.note: Tribhuvan University affiliated college in Jawalakhel, Lalitpur offering 4 year BTech in Food Technology (24 seats), BSc Microbiology and BBS.

providers_add.name: Nilgiri College
providers_add.note: Tribhuvan University affiliated college in Itahari, Sunsari offering 4 year BTech in Food Technology (24 seats) and BBS.

s-singa.covers: Full PhD tuition for up to 4 years, monthly stipend of SGD 2,700 rising to SGD 3,200 after passing the qualifying examination, one time airfare grant up to SGD 1,500 and settling in allowance of SGD 1,000 (bond free)
s-singa.how: Apply online at sms-applicant-app.a-star.edu.sg by 1 December 2026 (23:59 GMT+8) for the August 2027 intake across A*STAR, NUS, NTU, SUTD, SMU and SIT, or by 1 June 2027 for the January 2028 intake (A*STAR and NTU only).

s-sisgp.how: First apply to up to four eligible Swedish master programmes on universityadmissions.se by mid January, then submit the Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP) application on si.se during the February portal window.

s-vliruos.how: Apply directly through the participating Flemish university website (KU Leuven, Ghent University, University of Antwerp, VUB or Hasselt University) for an eligible ICP Connect master programme between October and the 1 February / 1 March scholarship deadline.

s-jds-japan.who: Permanent gazetted Nepal Government civil servants (Level 7 and above under the Civil Service Act) aged 25 to 40 with at least 3 years of civil service experience (20 Master seats and 2 PhD seats per year)
s-jds-japan.how: Submit applications through the JDS Project Office in Kathmandu (jds-scholarship.org) between September and November (10 November deadline for the 2026/27 cycle).

s-ugc.how: Apply online at ugcnepal.edu.np when the University Grants Commission publishes its annual Falgun/Chaitra call for Higher Education National Scholarships and MPhil/PhD Research Fellowships.

s-iccr.how: Apply on the ICCR A2A portal (a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in) between February and April for undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD seats at Indian public universities.

s-italy.covers: Tuition waiver at Italian public universities, health insurance and a EUR 9,000 annual grant paid in three instalments (EUR 1,000 a month for 9 months)
s-italy.how: Submit your online application on the Study in Italy portal (studyinitaly.esteri.it) when the annual MAECI call opens between April and June.

s-rhodes.how: Apply for the Rhodes Global Scholarship (2 seats worldwide per year) between June and early August at rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk after obtaining a nomination through your university.

s-clarendon.how: No separate scholarship form is required: apply for any full time or part time master or DPhil course at the University of Oxford by the December or January course deadline to be automatically considered for roughly 200 annual Clarendon awards.

s-pu-scholarship.how: Apply online at scholarship.pu.edu.np during Ashadh (June to July) and sit the 3 hour 150 mark central scholarship exam (80 percent of seats reserved for community school SEE graduates and 20 percent for private school graduates).

faq_add.q: How are engineers and officers recruited at Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA)?
faq_add.a: NEA open competitive written exams for Level 4/5 Supervisors and Level 7 Engineers/Officers are conducted by the Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog). Candidates sit two 100 mark written papers (Paper 1 covers GK, the Electricity Act 2049, NEA bylaws and core basics; Paper 2 covers technical engineering or accounting/administration) followed by a 30 mark interview. Level 7 engineers must hold an NEC licence.

faq_add.q: What is the exam fee and structure for Nepal Telecom (NTC) Level 7 Engineer vacancies?
faq_add.a: Per the Kartik 13, 2083 Nepal Telecom vacancy notice, the application fee for Level 6 and Level 7 officers/engineers is NPR 700 (plus NPR 200 per additional inclusive group). Written exams are conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog across two 100 mark papers covering the Telecommunications Act 2053, ICT policy and discipline specific engineering or management, followed by an interview.

faq_add.q: How does the Rastriya Banijya Bank (RBB) Level 4 Assistant and Level 6 Officer exam work?
faq_add.a: RBB recruitment is conducted by Lok Sewa Aayog. Level 4 Assistant requires +2 and starts with a 45 minute, 100 mark objective MCQ pre-test (50 questions x 2 marks, pass mark 40) followed by two 100 mark written papers and a 30 mark interview. Level 6 Assistant Manager requires a Master degree (or Bachelor with 50 percent in Management/Economics) and has two 100 mark written papers and an interview. Application fees are NPR 800 for Level 4 and NPR 1,000 for Level 6.

faq_add.q: What is the EPS-TOPIK Korea exam fee, age limit and format in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Nepali citizens aged 18 to 39 years with no criminal record or colour blindness apply online at eoers.epsnepal.gov.np with a fee of USD 28 (about NPR 3,850 at the previous day Nepal Rastra Bank rate). The computer/UBT exam at Bhaisepati has 40 questions in 50 minutes without a break (20 Reading + 20 Listening, scored out of 200 points) followed by a sector skill test. Passed scores remain valid for 2 years.

faq_add.q: What tests and fees are required in Nepal for the Japan Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa?
faq_add.a: For SSW (i), candidates must pass both JFT-Basic (or JLPT N4; JLPT N3 for taxi/bus driver) and a sector skill evaluation test at Prometric test centers in Kathmandu, Lalitpur or Pokhara. Per Prometric Nepal (October to November 2026), JFT-Basic (60 minutes, 250 points total, 200 pass score) costs USD 36, Nursing Care costs USD 8 to 15, Construction USD 8, Auto Repair USD 31, Agriculture USD 33, Food Service USD 33 and Accommodation USD 55.

faq_add.q: Which colleges in Nepal offer BTech in Food Technology and how many seats do they have?
faq_add.a: Under Tribhuvan University (IOST), Central Campus of Technology (CCT Dharan) has 48 seats, while GoldenGate International College, Padmashree International College, National College (NIST), National College of Food Science and Technology (NCFST), Lalitpur Valley College, Birat Multiple College, Nilgiri College and Sunsari Technical College offer 24 seats each. Under Purbanchal University, CAFODAT in Lalitpur offers 48 seats.

faq_add.q: Where can I study Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Three institutions offer the 4 year BFA degree in Nepal: Lalitkala Campus (Bhotahiti, Kathmandu, TU constituent), Sirjana College of Fine Arts (Lazimpat, Kathmandu, TU affiliated, offering Painting, Traditional Nepali Painting, Sculpture, Graphic Communication, Classical Music and Dance) and Kathmandu University School of Arts (Hattiban, Lalitpur, offering Studio Art and Graphic Communication).

faq_add.q: Which universities in Nepal offer Master of Pharmacy (MPharm) and what does it cost?
faq_add.a: The 2 year MPharm is offered by Kathmandu University (Industrial Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Care), Pokhara University School of Health and Allied Sciences (Clinical Pharmacy, Natural Product Pharmacy and Pharmaceutics), Purbanchal University (Clinical Pharmacy) and TU Institute of Medicine. Candidates need a BPharm degree, Nepal Pharmacy Council registration and a qualifying MECEE-PG score; total tuition is roughly NPR 5,00,000 to 6,00,000.

faq_add.q: Where can I study Master of Social Work (MSW) in Nepal?
faq_add.a: MSW is offered at Tribhuvan University Central Department in Kirtipur and affiliated campuses such as St. Xavier College (Maitighar), Thames International College and Padmakanya Multiple Campus, as well as under Pokhara, Purbanchal and Mid-West University social work programmes.

faq_add.q: What does the SINGA PhD scholarship in Singapore cover and when is the deadline?
faq_add.a: The Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA) covers full PhD tuition for up to 4 years at A*STAR, NUS, NTU, SUTD, SMU or SIT, a bond free monthly stipend of SGD 2,700 rising to SGD 3,200 after the qualifying exam, up to SGD 1,500 for flights and a SGD 1,000 settling in allowance. The deadline for the August 2027 intake is 1 December 2026 (1 June 2027 for the January 2028 intake at A*STAR and NTU).

faq_add.q: Who can apply for the JDS Japan Master scholarship in Nepal?
faq_add.a: The Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resource Development Scholarship (JDS) in Nepal is reserved exclusively for permanent gazetted Nepal Government civil servants (Level 7 and above) aged 25 to 40 with at least 3 years of service. It funds 20 Master fellows and 2 PhD fellows per year in Japan, with applications closing in October or November at jds-scholarship.org.

faq_add.q: How does the two step application work for the Swedish Institute (SISGP) scholarship?
faq_add.a: First, apply for up to four eligible Swedish master programmes on universityadmissions.se between October and mid January. Second, submit your separate Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP) application on si.se during the February application window.

faq_add.q: How much does the MAECI Italian Government scholarship pay international master students?
faq_add.a: The MAECI scholarship (applied for on studyinitaly.esteri.it between April and June) provides a tuition fee waiver at public Italian universities, health insurance and a EUR 9,000 annual grant paid in three instalments (EUR 1,000 per month over 9 months).

faq_add.q: Do I need a separate application form for the Oxford Clarendon Scholarship?
faq_add.a: No. Every applicant who submits an application for a full time or part time master or DPhil course at the University of Oxford by the course December or January deadline is automatically considered for roughly 200 annual fully funded Clarendon scholarships.

faq_add.q: When do VLIR-UOS ICP Connect scholarships in Belgium open for Nepali students?
faq_add.a: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect full master scholarships at KU Leuven, Ghent University, University of Antwerp, VUB and Hasselt University open between October and February each year (most programme deadlines fall on 1 February or 1 March) and cover full tuition, flights, insurance and a monthly living stipend for about 150 scholars globally.

faq_add.q: When does UGC Nepal open its annual national scholarship and fellowship applications?
faq_add.a: The University Grants Commission (UGC Nepal, Sanothimi) opens online applications at ugcnepal.edu.np in Falgun/Chaitra (February to March) for need based Higher Education National Scholarships (for Dalit, Muslim women, Mukta Kamlari, martyr/conflict families and students with disabilities) as well as Master, MPhil and PhD research fellowships.

faq_add.q: Which constituent campuses of Tribhuvan University offer +2 and Bachelor in Education (BEd)?
faq_add.a: Major TU constituent and community campuses offering Education programmes include Sanothimi Campus (Bhaktapur), Mahendra Ratna Campus (Tahachal, Kathmandu), Prithvi Narayan Campus (Pokhara), Saptagandaki Multiple Campus (Bharatpur), Butwal Kalika Campus (Butwal), Thakur Ram Multiple Campus (Birgunj), Mahendra Ratna Multiple Campus (Ilam) and Surkhet Multiple Campus (Birendranagar).

faq_add.q: Where can I study Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC) in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Four year Journalism and Mass Communication / Media Studies degrees are offered at Ratna Rajya Laxmi Campus (RR Campus, Exhibition Road), Padmakanya Multiple Campus (Bagbazar), St. Xavier College (Maitighar), Thames International College (Old Baneshwor), Mahendra Morang Adarsha Multiple Campus (Biratnagar) and Kathmandu University School of Arts (Hattiban).
